system_prompt_style.note: Paper only; no prompt construction described.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Discovery tasks hide data-quality or API issues that the Executor must surface through active exploration.
env_context_strategy.note: Executor explores workspace with tools; Planner receives full requirements.

context_compaction.note: No harness source; context-window overflow mentioned but no compaction mechanism.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Every role is a tool-calling loop in its own sandbox with tools.
tool_call_format.note: Inferred from 'tool-calling loop'; parser not shown.

tool_count.evidence_quote: Solo is a single agent with the full spec, workspace, and four tools.
tool_count.note: Solo condition; per-role tool sets differ and are not enumerated.

protocol_standardization.note: No dependency list or source available.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Every role is a tool-calling loop in its own sandbox with tools.
loop_primitives.note: Each role runs a tool loop; roles run in fixed Planner->Executor->Verifier sequence (single-pass file-based protocol).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: The Planner reads the full requirements but cannot modify the workspace. The Executor can edit and test the workspace, but only receives a summarized brief rather than the full specification.
planning_granularity.note: Planner produces a brief handed to Executor; closest is delegated plan. Could be explicit_plan_object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Full Team Planner + Executor + Verifier Planner Executor Verifier
multi_agent_topology.note: Default Full Team; Solo, Restricted, No-Plan, No-Evaluate conditions reachable.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Because no role has all three permissions, a successful run requires information to move across roles.
delegation_mechanism.note: File-based handoff between role containers; closest value.

human_in_loop.note: Human study platform lets humans fill roles, which is replacement not gating.

self_verification.evidence_quote: The Verifier reads the full requirements and read-only evidence from the Executor, then issues the final pass-or-fail verdict.
self_verification.note: Verifier is a separate agent role.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: The current harness uses capped turns and a file-based workflow. It does not test multi-round dialogue, dynamic role assignment, or within-provider model-size scaling.
retry_policy.note: Single-pass protocol stated; no retry on verifier rejection described.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: The current harness uses capped turns and a file-based workflow.
termination_condition.note: Verifier attestation also closes the run; other conditions not reported.

cost_controls.note: Costs are reported, no control mechanism described.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Each role runs in a separate container with access only to the files and tools needed for that role.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Sandboxes restrict which files each role can read or write.
filesystem_access.note: Relative to per-role containers; Verifier has read-only evidence.

permission_model.evidence_quote: We study this question by enforcing role separation with operating system permissions.
permission_model.note: Fixed per-role OS permissions and tool sets.

tracing.evidence_quote: TEAMBENCHreports both quantities and the per-turn rubric needed to compute role violations.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Each task includes a deterministic script grader.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Enforcement reduces Verifier code-edit attempts from 256 to 72

target_domain.evidence_quote: We adapt 650 GitHub bug reports from active open source repositories, including Flask, Django, NumPy, SciPy, and Keras.
target_domain.note: Also data science and incident-response tasks.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: The leaderboard evaluates 13 models across four families (Anthropic, Google, OpenAI, and Alibaba).

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: We release the benchmark, harness, and human study platform
primary_artifact.note: Coded from arXiv 2605.07073v1 only; repo not in bundle.

pinned_version.note: No repo or version in evidence.
